opening.argument: The presentation offers a concrete assurance that viewers can earn crypto “without any risk” through a new launch pool, while pairing that assurance with returns of up to 464% APR, or around 1.5% daily. It explains how to stake assets in the CLND and CORE pools and frames participation as an opportunity to earn, rather than merely reporting on the project. The speaker then directs viewers seeking to earn money to subscribe to a Telegram channel. Those promises of risk-free earnings, unusually high returns, and an earning-oriented invitation to participate establish a direct promotion of the investment pool.

citations.quote: The new launch pool at Gate.io gives you opportunity to earn crypto without any risk.
A total of 80,000 tokens will be distributed, with an impressive APR of 464%. That's around a 1.5% daily return.
So, if you want to earn money with it, don't forget to subscribe to my Telegram channel
